title: Block-bootstrap 90% CI for TAIEX-to-Individual amplification ratio under canonical full-sample BW-robust GJR-GARCH(1,1)

config.estimator: arch package GJR-GARCH(1,1) Normal, Constant mean
config.validity_rule: TAIEX must converge AND >=5 of 9 individuals must converge

matched_sample_2008_2024.note: Apples-to-apples; both TAIEX and 9 individuals on identical 2008-2024 window.

mixed_sample_paper_headline.note: Reproduces paper body.tex §3.2 headline 10× ratio = 0.272 (TAIEX over 1997-2026, n=7148) / 0.027 (9-indiv over 2008-2024, n=4170). This is the source of the 10× headline.

point_estimate_sanity.research_honesty_flag: The paper's 10× headline (body.tex §3.2) is constructed from MIXED samples: TAIEX over 1997-2026 (29 years, includes 1997 Asian crisis + 2000 dot-com bust) vs individual stocks over 2008-2024 (17 years, post-GFC era only). On the matched 2008-2024 sample (apples-to-apples), the ratio shrinks substantially. K1370 reports the matched-sample bootstrap CI as the primary finding; the mixed-sample CI would require bootstrapping TAIEX with its own 1997-2026 sample (different n) and is out of scope for this script.

replicate_count.validity_rule: TAIEX gamma converged AND >=5/9 individuals converged

lookahead_free_certification: Each replicate is an independent in-sample MLE on a block-bootstrap resample of full-sample log returns. No conditioning on future observations. No t→t+1 leak. Seeds fixed: np.random.seed(42); per-replicate bootstrap_seed = 42 + r; per-series sub-seed uses MD5(ticker) (process-stable; replaces hash(ticker) which is PYTHONHASHSEED-randomized — K1370-v2 fix per Codex CRITICAL 2026-05-16). All arch fits use cov_type='robust'.
notes: Replaces stale CI [2.8, 8.1] in paper/taiwan-vt/body.tex §3.2 which was constructed around draft 5x point estimate under rolling-window NW-HAC. This K1370 CI is the canonical estimate under K1302+K1302b full-sample BW-robust GJR-GARCH spec. Reduced N_start=10 vs 100 in K1302 for tractability (B=1000 × 10 series × 10 starts = 100000 total MLE fits, vs B × 10 × 100 = 1000000 fits at N_start=100).
